operation.summary: The API registry: every API group with its fixed name and number, its calls, and the one permission that governs them (API access, on by default, all-or-nothing for now)
operation.returns: permission {id: api_access, name, default: true, granular: false, you}, count, calls, apis[number, id, name, permission, default, allowed, calls["METHOD /v1/path" or "tool <name>"]]; numbers never change or get reused
